-- ruleid: whole-row-sql-file
CREATE VIEW active AS SELECT * FROM users WHERE active;
CREATE VIEW names AS SELECT id, name FROM users;
-- ruleid: json-column
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN settings jsonb;
SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM users);
SELECT id FROM a WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT * FROM b WHERE b.a = a.id
);
